Step 2 says sufficiently large entry scale / narrowed compact bare-coupling interval can make the entry norm as small as desired.
Step 3 reduces to x_{n+1}<=rho x_n + C x_n^2 in the small ball.
Lemma A.10 is printed without a smallness/invariant-ball condition and its induction invokes an impossible positive-r condition.
A.59 has a positive additive floor C r^2/(1-rho), so that displayed bound alone does not imply convergence to zero.
